_read_me: Launch settings for zemaris.com. Fill these in, then run: python _build.py. Empty text shows as [PLACEHOLDER] on the pages. Nothing here is secret: the Paddle client-side token is made to be public. Never put an API key, webhook secret or password in this file. See LAUNCH-PREP.md.

licence._note: true when the public build has ACTIVATE_URL set (the activation server is deployed). Changes the licence text on the Support and Features pages.

pdf_prices._note: Velocity PDF live Paddle price ids (14 Nov 2026); keep them the same as in the licence server's server/wrangler.toml PRICES (the same id in both). Until an id is a real pri_ id (pri_ + 26 letters/digits) the Velocity PDF Buy buttons say Coming soon.

pdf_windows._note: Velocity PDF installer. version/file/base_url set; size, sha256 and date are filled by python _release.py --product pdf. pdf_open stays false until the owner publishes: the pages then say Download available soon.
